assumptions.text: Stripe is the payment provider. The plan references Stripe objects but never says it is mandated.
assumptions.why: Billing plan section 2 uses Stripe terminology throughout

assumptions.text: Keep legacy invoices read-only instead of migrating them.
assumptions.why: Migrating 40k rows has no stated requirement
assumptions.alt: One-off backfill into the new schema

assumptions.text: Seat limits are enforced in the application layer, not by a database constraint.
assumptions.why: Limits change per plan, so a constraint would need a migration each time
assumptions.alt: Check constraint driven by a plans table

assumptions.text: Prorate seat changes to the day, matching Stripe default behaviour.
assumptions.why: Plan is silent; this needs no custom logic
assumptions.alt: Apply changes from the next billing cycle
assumptions.note: Apply seat changes from the next billing cycle instead

assumptions.text: Seat picker caps at 50 seats, then shows "contact sales".
assumptions.why: Common pattern; keeps large accounts on invoicing
